title: 第15章 邪祟

content_zh:
只是李长宇自己放不下。
他没从我嘴里得到有用的线索，看上去很失落。
李长宇道：“你以后有什么打算。”
我答道：“走一步算一步。”
嘴上虽然这样说，但下一步我已经想好，去省城找到叶文强叔叔问清楚那纸婚约的事。
还就是找到一叶那个混蛋。
当时一叶自称自己是布衣神相门的人，女鬼说这一切都是他的诡计，他是元凶。
我一定要找到他。
李长宇点了点头：“这之前，你必须跟我回警局做一份笔录。”
这家伙还真是执著，他根本没打算放弃调查。
西川市警局留守的人不多。
稀稀落落。
灯光倒是开的很亮，整个大厅被日光灯照得跟白天一样。
我被带进了审讯室。
审讯室就是另外一番景象了，里面黑压压的。
我坐在一张冰冷的椅子上，突然一道强光打在我的脸上，让我极不舒服。
人在这种情况下会感到恐慌，还有焦躁。
但这对我影响并不大。
李长宇跟小林警官坐在对面的黑暗之中，李长宇审讯，小林警官记录。
这是警局的正常审讯流程。

由于强光打在我的脸上，我一直闭着眼睛，可紧闭的双眼前一个影子总在晃来晃去。
伸手挡住强光。
往李长宇的影子望去，他倒映在墙壁上的影子一直在动。
可他却坐在那里从未动过。
这让我顿时紧张了起来，怎么回事？
李长宇开始审讯了。
该问的该说的在来的路上我已经全说了，他们还要不断的重复，如果说的对不上，那么我就有麻烦了。
幸亏我记性很好，而且我说的也不全是谎话。
李长宇极有耐心重重复复的一共问了我四次，可我的答案全都一致。
他有些累了，站起来走出了审讯室。
小林警官伸手把打在我脸上的强光给关了，只开着他办公桌上的一盏光线柔和的台灯。
我说道：“警官，李队长有问题。”
小林警官整理着笔录随口道：“什么问题？”
我说：“他的影子有问题。”
小林警官失声笑了起来：“影子有问题！那要怎么办，要不要做一场法事超度一下，要收费吗？”
我知道他不信。
跟他一起走出审讯室，李长宇就站在审讯室跟大厅之间的走廊上抽烟。
灯光很明亮。
李长宇的影子清晰无比的投映在墙壁上。
小林警官不由自主的望向李长宇的影子，随即他的脸上露出了极其惊愕的表情。

我看向李长宇的影子时也大吃了一惊。
他的影子从脚开始往上以肉眼可见的速度在消失，就好像被吃了一样，而且速度极快。
估计整个影子完全消失不会超过半分钟。
就这么一个反应的时间。
影子的脚部至大腿根已经完全消失了。
小林警官吃惊的目瞪口呆了。
这现象太诡异了，完全违背光学理论。
走廊的墙壁上挂着一面红色的锦旗，上面写着‘罪恶克星’，应该是市民送给警队的。
我一个箭步冲了上去。
用力一扯，锦旗被我扯开一条口子，抽出一根红线拉着就向李长宇扑去。
同时用红线穿过一张之前准备好的小纸人的胸膛，再用打火机点燃纸人。
做好这些我正好冲到李长宇跟前，一把抓住他的手，让红绳不停地缠绕他的食指。
纸人燃烧带着红绳也烧了起来，火势顺着红绳极其迅速的向着李长宇的手指燃烧过来。
李长宇看到火势烧过来，本能的想要躲避，但却被我死死抓住。
我猛的用力，他的食指被我捏出一滴鲜血。
炽热的火焰已经灼烧上他的手指跟血液。
投在墙壁上的影子发出无比痛苦骇人的凄厉叫声，声音在寂静的警察局显得格外的突兀，格外的瘆人。
我握紧点着的打火机，使劲全身的力气向墙壁上的影子砸去。
打火机的汽油罐碎裂，里面的汽油一粘到火焰，发出一声惊人的爆炸声，一大团火焰冒了出来。
嗤嗤嗤！

墙壁灼烧着，留下一个成人大小的人体形态的烧焦轮廓。
这一切都发生在电光火石之间。
突然的让人莫名其妙。
李长宇震惊无比的望着墙上人体形态的烧焦轮廓，此时还冒着烟，散发出刺鼻的焦味。
墙壁的表层不只是烧焦的墙灰。
还有一层黑色物质。
李长宇度过初期的惊愕后，脸色绯红了起来，怒气越来越盛，他终于愤怒无比的道：“混蛋，你敢袭警，还敢纵火烧警局，你知道这是什么罪名吗？”

content_en:
It’s just that Li Changyu can’t let go.
He didn't get any useful clues from me and seemed disappointed.
Li Changyu said: "What are your plans in the future?"
I replied: "Take it one step at a time."
Although I said this, I had already thought about the next step. I would go to the provincial capital to find Uncle Ye Wenqiang and ask him about the marriage contract.
Or just find that bastard Kazuha.
At that time, Yiye claimed that he was a member of Buyi Shen Xiangmen. The female ghost said that all this was his trick and he was the culprit.
I must find him.
Li Changyu nodded: "Before that, you must go back to the police station with me to make a record."
This guy is really persistent, and he has no intention of giving up the investigation.
There are not many people left at the Xichuan City Police Station.
Sparse.
The lights were turned on very brightly, and the entire hall was illuminated by fluorescent lamps as if it were daytime.
I was taken into the interrogation room.
The interrogation room was a different scene, it was dark inside.
I was sitting on a cold chair, and suddenly a bright light hit my face, which made me extremely uncomfortable.
People will feel panicked and anxious in this situation.
But it doesn't affect me that much.
Li Changyu and Officer Xiaolin sat across from each other in the darkness. Li Changyu interrogated and Officer Xiaolin recorded.
This is the normal interrogation procedure of the police station.
Because the bright light hit my face, I kept my eyes closed, but a shadow was always dangling in front of my closed eyes.
Put out your hand to block the bright light.
Looking at Li Changyu's shadow, his shadow reflected on the wall kept moving.
But he sat there and never moved.
This made me immediately nervous, what's going on?
Li Changyu began the interrogation.
I had already said all the things that needed to be asked and said on the way here, and they had to keep repeating them. If what they said was not correct, then I would be in trouble.
Luckily I have a good memory and I wasn't entirely lying.
Li Changyu patiently asked me four times in total, but my answers were all the same.
He was a little tired, stood up and walked out of the interrogation room.
Officer Xiaolin reached out and turned off the bright light that hit my face, and only turned on a soft lamp on his desk.
I said, "Officer, Captain Li has a problem."
Officer Xiaolin compiled the transcript and said casually: "What's the problem?"
I said, "There's something wrong with his shadow."
Officer Xiaolin burst out laughing: "There is a problem with the shadow! What should I do? Do I need to do a ritual to pray for my salvation? Is there any charge?"
I know he doesn't believe it.
After walking out of the interrogation room with him, Li Changyu stood smoking in the corridor between the interrogation room and the hall.
The lights are bright.
Li Changyu's shadow was reflected clearly on the wall.
Officer Xiaolin couldn't help but look at Li Changyu's shadow, and then his face showed an expression of extreme shock.
I was also surprised when I looked at Li Changyu's shadow.
His shadow began to disappear from his feet upwards at a speed visible to the naked eye, as if he had been eaten, and at an extremely fast speed.
It is estimated that it will not take more than half a minute for the entire shadow to completely disappear.
Just such a reaction time.
The shadow's legs to thighs have completely disappeared.
Officer Xiaolin was stunned and stunned.
This phenomenon is so weird that it completely violates optical theory.
There is a red pennant hanging on the wall of the corridor with the words 'Crime Busters' written on it. It should have been given to the police force by the citizens.
I rushed forward with a lunge.
With a strong tug, I tore a hole in the pennant, pulled out a red thread and threw it towards Li Changyu.
At the same time, pass a red thread through the chest of a small paper figurine prepared before, and then use a lighter to light the paper figurine.
After doing this, I rushed to Li Changyu, grabbed his hand, and let the red rope wrap around his index finger.
The paper figurine burned along with the red rope, and the fire followed the red rope very quickly towards Li Changyu's fingers.
Li Changyu saw the fire coming over, I instinctively wanted to avoid it, but I grabbed it tightly.
I exerted great force, and a drop of blood came out from his index finger.
The hot flames had burned his fingers and blood.
The shadow cast on the wall made an extremely painful and horrifying scream. The sound was particularly abrupt and terrifying in the silent police station.
I held the lit lighter tightly and threw it at the shadow on the wall with all my strength.
The lighter's gasoline can shattered, and as soon as the gasoline inside hit the flame, it made an astonishing explosion, and a large ball of flame came out.
Tsk tsk tsk!
The walls burned, leaving the charred outline of an adult-sized human form.
It all happened in the blink of an eye.
The suddenness is baffling.
Li Changyu stared in shock at the charred outline of the human form on the wall, which was still smoking and emitting a pungent burnt smell.
The surface of the wall is more than just burnt plaster.
There is also a layer of black substance.
After Li Changyu got over the initial shock, his face turned red and his anger became more and more intense. He finally said angrily: "Asshole, you dare to attack the police and set fire to the police station. Do you know what the crime is?"
